recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of two male performers in ornate, rhinestone-embellished blue suits, framed within a large circular graphic border that contains radial typography. The aesthetic is defined by soft studio lighting, a lavender-to-grey gradient background, and a structured circular composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction with the circular frame
Contrast between the vibrant blue suits and the muted lavender background
Radial alignment of text following the curve of the circle
Staggered height of the two subjects creating a diagonal internal line

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects centered, one standing and one seated, occupying the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular white line that frames the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, follow the circle clockwise, and settle on the faces of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample lavender-grey space in the corners outside the circular frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Lavender-grey background providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cerulean and navy blue of the suits providing visual weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the circular line and primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing against low saturation in the background; high value contrast between white text and dark blue fabric.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool tones (blues, purples, greys)

composition.position: Top and bottom arcs of the circle
Left and right sides of the circle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with weight and color variations.
graphicDevices: Small circular bullet points as separators

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and circular 'O's.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of two men in 1970s ornate blue rhinestone suits against a lavender-grey gradient background. Leave a large circular area clear for text overlays. The men should be positioned one standing and one sitting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin white circular border. Place uppercase geometric sans-serif text along the top and bottom arcs in white, and along the left and right arcs in light blue, following the curve of the circle.

verificationChecks: Is the text following the circular path?
Are the suits sufficiently detailed with rhinestones?
Is the background a soft lavender-grey gradient?
Is the typography in a clean geometric sans-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility along the curve
Ensure the circular border is perfectly round
Verify the rhinestone texture looks realistic
Confirm the color palette remains cool-toned
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Circular Frame + Radial Geometric Sans-Serif + 1970s Embellished Fashion
